personal.bio:
I'm Abdulkarim — a senior full-stack engineer based in Addis Ababa with 5+ years shipping software for clients around the world. I'm Top Rated Plus on Upwork with a 100% Job Success score — $60K+ earned across 26 jobs and 4,289 tracked hours — and I've built everything from fintech banking backends to AI-assisted call-management systems.

These days I work where web engineering meets applied AI: designing Next.js and NestJS platforms, wiring up LLM features and AI agents with LangChain, LangGraph, and CrewAI, and training and evaluating frontier models — RLHF, prompt engineering, side-by-side comparison — including LLM-training work for Google via Turing. I care about clean architecture, measurable impact, and code that survives contact with real users.

I also published research on hate-speech detection for Afan Oromo, a low-resource language, reaching 90%+ accuracy — because I like hard problems that matter.
